title: Bengaluru Court issues summons to Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge for remarks against RSS
description: A Bengaluru court on June 27 issued summons to Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge and Youth Congress leader Mohammed Nalapad on a criminal defamation complaint filed against them for their remarks against Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS).
